idea-plugin.name: ADA Title II Deadline Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Flags the ADA Title II and HHS Section 504 deadlines that both agencies reset in 2026, and the WCAG 2.1 Level AA failures your source code can actually show.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → ADA Title II Deadline Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 26 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/ada-title-ii-deadline-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/ada-title-ii-deadline-lint

action.text: ADA Title II Deadline Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run ADA Title II Deadline Lint on the file in the editor
